variables.label: Inclusionary zoning ("Workforce Housing")
variables.value: 10% of units in developments of ≥20 units (≥12 units in CBD/SSDD); up to 20–30% density bonus available
variables.quote: Developments of twenty (20) or more dwelling units shall designate a minimum of ten percent (10%) of the total number of units, rounded up to the nearest whole number, as workforce housing units

variables.district: Norwalk Green Historic District only (not a citywide overlay)
variables.label: Historic overlay
variables.value: One small mapped district; certificate of appropriateness required for alteration/demolition within it

source.title: Norwalk Code of Ordinances, Chapter 56 (Historic District)

variables.quote: No building permit for erection of a building or structure or for alteration of an exterior architectural feature within an historic district and no demolition permit for demolition or removal of a building or structure within an historic district shall be issued

variables.label: Demolition delay
variables.value: Up to 120 days (2023 rewrite raised the ceiling from the 90-day state default); 90 days specifically within the Norwalk Green Historic District

source.title: Norwalk Code of Ordinances, Chapter 55 (Demolition Delay, amended 3/28/2023)

variables.quote: In no event shall the issuance of a Demolition permit be delayed for more than 120 days from the date the application is deemed filed.

hap_score.methodology_note: Computed from the Variables table on this page, not from the NZA data below. Six weighted components (Multifamily Access 30pts, Approval Discretion 10pts, Minimum Lot Size 20pts, ADU Approval Pathway 15pts, Parking Mandate 10pts, Demolition Delay 15pts) are each scored against a fixed, published rubric from a specific cited fact above. Higher = more restrictive.

v2.formula: V2 = sum(district score x acres) / sum(acres) over included districts
v2.method: Each district is scored with the same six-component rubric using only its own rules. The score uses four components that every town can document (multifamily access, approval discretion, minimum lot size, ADU pathway); a district is included only if all four are confirmed. Parking and demolition delay are shown as context but not scored, so towns share one scale. The town V2 score is the land-area-weighted mean of included district scores; acreage is from data/land_area/norwalk.json. Components with no confirmed input are excluded per district.
